name: dd9e937c-8b5f-5e15-b611-8c8b4651750a
description: Phone assistant that recognises the caller by their number, verifies them by email, tells them the status of an order and changes the shipping address of an order. The whole call is saved to Salesforce when it ends.

variableDeclarations.name: company_name
variableDeclarations.description: Client name used in the greeting and instructions.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_status
variableDeclarations.description: Set at the start of the call: known when the caller's number matched exactly one Salesforce Contact, otherwise unknown.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_name
variableDeclarations.description: First name of the Contact that matched the caller's number.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_email
variableDeclarations.description: Email address of that Contact, compared with what the caller says.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_contact_id
variableDeclarations.description: Salesforce Id of the matched Contact.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_account_id
variableDeclarations.description: Salesforce Id of the matched Contact's Account.

variableDeclarations.name: telephony-caller-id
variableDeclarations.description: The caller's phone number. The phone platform fills it on a real phone call; in Preview set a test number as its default and clear it before go-live.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_verified
variableDeclarations.description: True after verify_caller succeeded. Tools that need a verified caller check it.

variableDeclarations.name: verification_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Failed verification attempts so far in this session.

variableDeclarations.name: last_order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Salesforce Id of the order last looked up or changed (linked on the call transcript).
